seo.title: Accommodation — pitches, bungalows & glamping | Camping Cala Sereno
seo.description: Eight ways to stay under the pines: 70–100 m² pitches, bungalows with a porch, mobile homes and glamping tents. Prices and full details.

alojamientos.intro: Eight ways to sleep under the pines. You book the type; we assign the exact unit when you arrive, the way it's always been done.

fichas.ut_std: The classic pitch: compacted sand, partial Aleppo pine shade and room for a tent or caravan with the awning out.
fichas.ut_conf: More square metres and full shade. The 10 A hook-up runs the fridge and the caravan's air-con without a second thought.
fichas.ut_prem: The campsite's front row: the sea shows between the trunks and the breeze arrives on its own. These go first.
fichas.ut_moto: Made for motorhomes: wide access, firm level ground and a 10 A hook-up right on the pitch.
fichas.ut_bung4: Light wood, a shaded porch and two bedrooms. The classic for four who don't want to pitch anything.
fichas.ut_bung6: The family flagship: three bedrooms, two bathrooms and the sea from the porch. Saturday arrivals in August.
fichas.ut_mobil: A mobile home with everything solved: full kitchen, bathroom and air-con. The only lodging where pets are welcome.
fichas.ut_glamp: Raw canvas on a deck, a real bed and warm light. No air conditioning on purpose: the pine wood does the job.

seo.title: Facilities — pool, restaurant & services | Camping Cala Sereno
seo.description: A pool among the pines, a seasonal restaurant under canvas, a shop, renovated washrooms and direct access to the cove. All a shady stroll apart.

instalaciones.intro: Everything you need to leave the car parked all week, and nothing noisy: the luxury here is shade and firm ground.

items.desc: Open May to September, with a shallow end and loungers under the pine canopy. The water falls into shade by mid-afternoon.
Seasonal, under the big canvas: rice dishes to order, fish of the day and the coffee after the cove. Terrace on compacted sand.
Bread and papers in the morning, ice all day, fruit from the villages next door. March to October.
Two renovated blocks with hot water at all hours, a family cabin and an accessible bathroom. Cleaned three times a day in summer.
Token washers and dryers, a sink for delicates and a clothesline in the shade — your canvas will thank you.
A wooden playground under the pines and an open field where the usual match gets organised every evening.
A padel court, a fronton wall and a goal that has seen three generations. Book at reception, rackets included.
Our own 300 m path through the pine wood, with a shower on the way back. No roads to cross: kids go on their own.
Reception open 8 to 22 in season, wifi in common areas and most pitches. Plus honest local advice.

seo.title: The area — the cove, the trails and the towns | Camping Cala Sereno
seo.description: A pebble cove 300 m away, trails starting at reception, market towns ten minutes away and inland Castellón behind.

entornoPagina.intro: Cala Sereno exists because the cove existed first. Everything else — the trails, the towns, the rice dishes — was here before us.

secciones.texto: Three hundred metres of our own path through the pine wood and you're on a pebble cove with clear water, facing east: sun in the morning, cliff shade from five o'clock. There's a lifeguard in July and August; the rest of the year it belongs to early risers.

Three marked trails leave from reception: the cove path (10 minutes), the lighthouse path along the cliff (a good hour, best at sunset) and the climb to the high pine wood, where April smells of rosemary and the whole bay opens up.

Ten minutes by car there are two towns with a weekly market, a wood-fired bakery and bars where the mid-morning almuerzo is serious business. Tuesday is the big market: orchard fruit, cooperative olive oil and the pickle stall that has us conquered.

This is a land of soupy rice and fish straight from the market. Ask at reception: we keep a short list of the places where we eat ourselves, with phone numbers and first names. In season, call the day before.

seo.title: Rates by season | Camping Cala Sereno
seo.description: Nightly prices for pitches, bungalows and glamping in opening, mid and high season. Supplements, extras and tourist tax, no surprises.

tarifas.intro: Price per night, VAT included, by season. The final price is always calculated when you search for dates — what the front desk shows is what you pay.

items: Minimum stay: 3 nights on pitches and 7 in lodgings during high season; 2 nights in mid season.
Bungalows and mobile homes check in on Saturdays during high season.
The Valencian tourist tax is charged separately: per person per night, with children exempt.
Book 60 days ahead for a 10% discount. Stays of 14 nights or more: an extra 8%.
Lodging deposits are returned in full after the unit is checked on departure day.

seo.title: Contact & how to get here | Camping Cala Sereno
seo.description: Write, call or come and see us: Partida Cala Sereno s/n, Castellón, Spain. We reply within a day; in season, sooner.

contacto.intro: We answer fast and our phone has a name behind it. Write today and you'll hear back tomorrow — in season, usually the same day.

horario.texto: 8:00 to 22:00 in season (March–October). Arrivals from 13:00 on pitches and 16:00 in lodgings; departures before 12:00.

llegar.texto: Exit 43 off the AP-7, then eight minutes on the local road following the lighthouse signs. By train, the station is 20 minutes away: let us know and we'll arrange a taxi. The campsite turn-off is signposted — if the sat-nav hesitates, trust the brown sign.
